cases.scenario: 缺有权合同
cases.inputIntent: contract=MISSING
cases.expected: ASK; no recommendation

cases.scenario: 材料证据冲突
cases.inputIntent: same subject/current revision, incompatible confirmed observations
cases.expected: UNKNOWN; conflict evidence retained; no unconditional recommendation

cases.scenario: 旧 SHA 证据
cases.inputIntent: decision entry has only otherwise applicable evidence bound to an older SHA; no material conflict
cases.expected: UNKNOWN / STALE_EVIDENCE; never current recommendation or PASS

cases.scenario: 相同正则但保留空白与规范化语义不同
cases.inputIntent: business merge contradicts POSTCONDITION; independent pure helper keeps callers' differences
cases.expected: merge EXCLUDED; helper evaluated separately, not blanket excluded

cases.scenario: 相同算法不同错误/权限/Owner
cases.inputIntent: one material dimension NO; repeat independently for all nine applicable dimensions
cases.expected: each incompatible proposed merge EXCLUDED with precise evidence; no false equivalence

cases.scenario: 未确认语义维度
cases.inputIntent: material compatibility UNKNOWN or unsubstantiated omission
cases.expected: NEEDS_EVIDENCE; no supported merge

cases.scenario: 同 Owner 同不变量共同变化，多个实际维护位置
cases.inputIntent: known compatible shared mechanism and preserved public contract
cases.expected: PRIVATE_SHARED SUPPORTED, advisory not unique optimum

cases.scenario: 仅两段语法相同
cases.inputIntent: no proved shared invariant or change axis
cases.expected: no supported shared abstraction; missing facts visible

cases.scenario: 只因未来可能插件化而新增公开接口
cases.inputIntent: new public boundary and new strategy, relevant need facts all verified NO, no existing compatibility obligation, other required facts confirmed
cases.expected: both NOT_SUPPORTED; not hard Rule

cases.scenario: 现有公开 API 无新增扩展需求
cases.inputIntent: existing compatibility obligation YES
cases.expected: do not recommend removing API merely because new need NO

cases.scenario: 真实异构消费者、稳定替换需求
cases.inputIntent: genuine heterogeneous consumers need a stable public contract; preservation of authorized behavior confirmed
cases.expected: PUBLIC_CONTRACT SUPPORTED; compare viable alternative

cases.scenario: 合法动态扩展需求但失败语义不相容
cases.inputIntent: strategy would force incompatible failure semantics
cases.expected: EXCLUDED despite extension need

cases.scenario: 现有局部实现，无实质未决问题
cases.inputIntent: known current contract preserved and no independent change
cases.expected: KEEP_EXISTING; no extra interface

cases.scenario: 两个同样可行但成本不同的方案
cases.inputIntent: private shared vs module both supported, unresolved tradeoff
cases.expected: TRADEOFF; no fabricated optimum

cases.scenario: 测试 exit 0 但目标未执行
cases.inputIntent: verified receipt confirms target test was not executed despite runner exit 0; sole authorized obligation
cases.expected: obligation NOT_RUN; aggregate INCOMPLETE

cases.scenario: 未授权预期
cases.inputIntent: authorized obligation, but only ENGINEERING_HYPOTHESIS or DERIVED without verified derivation, no other eligible Oracle
cases.expected: obligation UNKNOWN; aggregate UNKNOWN; no primary pass/fail

cases.scenario: R20 原始短 Provider 反例
cases.inputIntent: frozen 8/8 public probes; exact observed 191-byte whole-body decode contradicts TASK L9–10; historical metadata classification unresolved
cases.expected: qualified failing obligation OBSERVED_FAIL; aggregate PUBLIC_CONTRACT_PARTIAL_OR_FAILED; no retroactive change or permission claim

cases.scenario: 部分覆盖、异 SHA/候选证据及合格反例
cases.inputIntent: three separate authorized obligations: incomplete qualified current pass coverage; only same-subject stale observation; separate current verified authorized counterexample, no conflicts
cases.expected: respectively UNKNOWN, STALE, OBSERVED_FAIL; aggregate PUBLIC_CONTRACT_PARTIAL_OR_FAILED

cases.scenario: 所有明确义务具有合格执行及范围证据
cases.inputIntent: nonempty authorized universe verified complete, each obligation bound to current subject/SHA, qualified DECLARED or checked DERIVED Oracle, verified discovered/executed result and adequate scope, no eligible conflicting/failing observation
cases.expected: all OBSERVED_PASS_SCOPED; aggregate TESTED_CONTRACTS_PASS_SCOPED only; not global PASS

cases.scenario: 实际 SDK query 预算不足
cases.inputIntent: real BoundedQueryElement.complete=false; workflow budget adequate
cases.expected: UNKNOWN / QUERY_INCOMPLETE; no inference from partial/empty data

cases.scenario: 实际 SDK workflow 预算耗尽
cases.inputIntent: valid request, actual SDK maxCalls exhausted before invokeOutcome
cases.expected: FAILED / WORKFLOW_CALL_BUDGET; skipped subsequent validator; no renewed root

cases.scenario: 同事实重复运行
cases.inputIntent: same stable input and selected source revision
cases.expected: identical assessment, no time/random/network dependence

cases.scenario: 不合法输入和未绑定证据
cases.inputIntent: otherwise valid bounded request, duplicate candidate ID or repeated dimension on same candidate (separate probes)
cases.expected: REJECT / DUPLICATE_ID; no partial business evaluation

cases.scenario: 真实源码消费
cases.inputIntent: separately authorized new code decision, pinned contract/actual facts/code, actual SDK invocation
cases.expected: record decision and observable behavior/falsifier; no causal gain claim; no new multi-Agent experiment

cases.scenario: 非法结构与身份
cases.inputIntent: otherwise valid request, wrong type/missing required identity/invalid SHA format (separate probes)
cases.expected: REJECT / INVALID_INPUT; no business evaluation

cases.scenario: 不支持的枚举
cases.inputIntent: otherwise valid request with unsupported candidate kind, fact value or dimension (separate probes)
cases.expected: REJECT / UNSUPPORTED_ENUM

cases.scenario: 超限拒绝
cases.inputIntent: otherwise well-formed inputs at limit+1 independently: 6 candidates, 10 dimension records in one candidate, 65 facts, 129 evidence records, 129 total refs; Validator 65 obligations or 129 observations; repeated refs count
cases.expected: REJECT / INPUT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; no truncation/partial assessment

cases.scenario: 引用悬空或跨主体
cases.inputIntent: otherwise valid request with dangling evidenceRef or verified binding to another candidate/obligation (separate probes)
cases.expected: REJECT / EVIDENCE_REFERENCE_INVALID; no evaluation

cases.scenario: 合格证据与自报对照
cases.inputIntent: same authorized universe and otherwise identical all-green A19 observation fields, but no trusted confirmation; ordinary observations even claim VERIFIED_OBSERVATION
cases.expected: all UNKNOWN; aggregate UNKNOWN; cannot self-promote

cases.scenario: 缩小合同义务集合
cases.inputIntent: known authorized universe has two obligations; caller supplies observations only for one green obligation, no evidence of the second
cases.expected: first OBSERVED_PASS_SCOPED if independently qualified; second UNKNOWN; aggregate UNKNOWN; use authorized universe

cases.scenario: 未确认完整或空义务集合
cases.inputIntent: all supplied observations green but universe not confirmed complete; separately empty authorized set
cases.expected: aggregate UNKNOWN in both; never vacuous PASS

cases.scenario: 同范围合格证据冲突
cases.inputIntent: two separately verified contradictory observations same obligation/current subject and same coverage, unresolved; sole obligation
cases.expected: CONFLICT; aggregate UNKNOWN; neither last observation nor count decides

cases.scenario: 稳定公共接口不需要 Strategy
cases.inputIntent: two real consumers require stable common API; replacement/dynamic variation need confirmed NO; both candidate types preserve contract, no existing strategy obligation
cases.expected: PUBLIC_CONTRACT SUPPORTED; new STRATEGY NOT_SUPPORTED

cases.scenario: 有权替换需求且合同相容
cases.inputIntent: actual authorized multiple implementation replacement axis and verified common contract, including error/authority/state/cleanup; other facts adequate
cases.expected: STRATEGY SUPPORTED; advisory only

cases.scenario: 仅自报反例
cases.inputIntent: authorized universe and Oracle, current apparent failing execution but no independent/authorized verification; sole observation
cases.expected: obligation UNKNOWN; aggregate UNKNOWN; no OBSERVED_FAIL

cases.scenario: 不明是否运行
cases.inputIntent: authorized obligation, no verified evidence of execution or nonexecution; sole obligation
cases.expected: obligation UNKNOWN; aggregate UNKNOWN; not NOT_RUN

cases.scenario: 超限与重复同时出现
cases.inputIntent: top-level shape/identity valid, collection beyond limit and repeated ID
cases.expected: REJECT / INPUT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; no partial business evaluation

cases.scenario: 候选业务上限边界
cases.inputIntent: 5 candidates, at most 9 distinct dimensions each, exactly 64 facts, 128 evidence records and total refs, otherwise valid qualified input
cases.expected: not INPUT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; evaluate actual facts within SDK budget

cases.scenario: 合格反例与未确认全量合同
cases.inputIntent: one independently verified authorized current counterexample, obligation universe not confirmed complete; no contradictory qualified evidence in same scope
cases.expected: OBSERVED_FAIL; aggregate PUBLIC_CONTRACT_PARTIAL_OR_FAILED; completeness gap retained

cases.scenario: 自报矛盾不能覆盖合格观察
cases.inputIntent: same authorized sole obligation; A19 verified scoped pass plus unverified self-reported failure
cases.expected: retain qualified OBSERVED_PASS_SCOPED and self-report qualification; aggregate TESTED_CONTRACTS_PASS_SCOPED

cases.scenario: 仅旧版本观察
cases.inputIntent: complete authorized universe with sole obligation; only verified observation belongs to older SHA of same candidate
cases.expected: STALE; aggregate INCOMPLETE; no current pass

cases.scenario: 仅自报合同获权
cases.inputIntent: request claims CONFIRMED and current SHA, but no trusted source confirmation; no confirmed conflict/staleness
cases.expected: UNKNOWN / EVIDENCE_UNQUALIFIED; no recommendation

cases.scenario: 声明覆盖范围不足
cases.inputIntent: sole authorized obligation, verified authorized current passing execution covers only a strict subset of declared scope; no other observations
cases.expected: UNKNOWN; aggregate UNKNOWN; no scoped PASS for full declared scope

cases.scenario: 已核对观察内容被替换
cases.inputIntent: trusted confirmation for a current executed observation with partial passing coverage; ordinary input reuses the observationId but changes coverage to full (or replaces result/Oracle)
cases.expected: modified ordinary observation not qualified; original verified partial coverage remains UNKNOWN; aggregate UNKNOWN; no pass based on ID
